title: Magenta Pure Kanjivaram Silk Saree with Peach
description: A deep magenta Kanjivaram silk saree from Muhurth, woven in the timeless Korvai technique and enriched with the finesse of Banarasi-inspired artistry. The body is adorned with silver zari floral blossoms that shimmer gently across the canvas, while delicate Meenakari detailing in pastel pink, blue, and green adds a graceful flourish to the intricate gold zari vines. The contrast peach getti pettu border is finely crafted with traditional patterns reminiscent of old-world grandeur, offering a quiet yet captivating complement to the vibrant body. The pallu carries forward the richness of the weave with ornate detailing and rhythmic zari work, tying the narrative together in one flowing, elegant stroke. Paired with a peach-hued brocade blouse, this saree is an elevated expression of bridal beauty where colour, texture, and tradition unite in quiet splendor.

title: Red Pure Zari Kanjivaram Silk Saree
description: Bright Red Pure Zari Kanjivaram Silk Saree featuring graceful Kamalam buttas across the body, with Big Annam motifs elegantly spaced just above the border. The small border itself is adorned with intricate Mayil Kannu designs, while the contrast young betel leaf green pallu comes alive with richly woven royal Yaali, elephant, and annam motifs. Paired with a plain blouse, this saree’s distinctive colour pairing and refined detailing make it a standout choice for any occasion.

title: Red Pure Zari Kanjivaram Silk Saree with Cream
description: A striking bridal red Kanjivaram silk saree from Muhurth, this pure zari weave captures the essence of tradition with remarkable finesse. The body features classic Kuthu Kattam or Veldhari checks in rich gold zari, forming a luminous grid that brings structure and elegance to the vivid red base. Framed by an off-white Retta Pettu Korvai border, the saree is detailed with finely woven mango motifs—crafted with precision and restraint, allowing the vibrance of the red to take centre stage. The pallu is grand and intricately woven, continuing the refined language of the drape without excess. Paired with a plain off-white blouse, this exclusive piece from Muhurth reflects meticulous craftsmanship and timeless appeal—ideal for wedding moments where colour, tradition, and distinction come together in harmony.

title: Red Pure Zari Kanjivaram Silk Saree with Green
description: In a vibrant red, this Pure Zari Kanjivaram Silk Saree carries the elegance of fineoosi-checkswoven across the body, lending a refined geometry to the drape. The saree is framed by abodi pettuborder in radiant gold zari, with magenta pink bands along the selvedge adding a soft yet striking highlight. The pallu is richly detailed with traditional Kanchipuram motifs from yaanai and kudhirai to vanki and floral forms woven in the timeless grammar of the craft. Paired with a contrasting plain blouse, this saree is light, graceful, and easy to carry, making it a perfect choice for intimate gatherings and special functions.

title: Dark Magenta Pure Zari Kanjivaram Silk Saree
description: In a deep, regal shade of dark magenta, this Pure Zari Kanjivaram Silk Saree carries the grace of vintage Kanchi artistry. The body is adorned with annam and kamalam butta, accented by thazhampoo rek in oosi stripes placed just above the border. The Traditional Getti Pettu border is enriched with muthu seer, bhavanji, and rudraksh motifs, brought to life through the mastery of seasoned weavers. Woven in a timeless Kanchi tone, it features a rich traditional pallu and a plain blouse, making it a treasured choice for grand occasions.

title: Orange Pure Kanjivaram Silk Saree with Lavender
description: Some sarees arrive like a celebration — vibrant, intricate, and unforgettable. This Orange Pure Kanjivaram Silk Saree with a Lavender contrast from our bridal edit is one such piece. The mango yellow-toned body features a refined geometrical brocade, adding structure and radiance to the drape. Its Korvai Turning Border is a visual delight, detailed with Paithani-inspired peacocks and parrots in hues of green, orange, wine, and silver zari. The Meenakari detailing adds a lively, contemporary touch to this otherwise traditional frame. A richly woven pallu and a matching brocade blouse complete the ensemble. A bold and beautiful statement saree from Muhurth — crafted for the bride who seeks colour, culture, and exquisite craftsmanship.

title: Violet Vaira-Oosi Pure Zari Kanjivaram Silk Saree
description: This Violet Vaira-Oosi Pure Zari Kanjivaram Silk Saree is a timeless recreation of the vintage weaves from the 1960s. The body is adorned with delicate vaira-oosi stripes with geometric kothu buttas crafted with precision and restraint, leaving the saree borderless for a refined appeal. Woven in a traditional violet shade, the rich zari pallu shimmers with quiet grandeur and is  paired with a plain blouse. This saree embodies classic craftsmanship and an eternal charm, making it an ideal choice for every occasion.

title: Peacock Blue Pure Kanjivaram Silk Saree with Dark Magenta
description: This striking Peacock Blue Kanjivaram silk saree is paired with a rich Dark Magenta Korvai border, creating a bold and elegant contrast. The border is crafted in the classic Retta Pettu style, detailed with intricate silver zari with modern floral designs at the base and traditional salangai patterns with moplah highlights above, blending heritage with a touch of contemporary flair. The body features dual-toned zari buttas with stylised pine tree motifs woven in gold and silver, arranged in perfect symmetry across the deep blue canvas. The pallu continues the grandeur with elaborate floral motifs and repeating floral bands drawn from the border, lending depth and cohesion to the drape. Completed with a plain dark magenta blouse, this saree is a refined choice for festive occasions and memorable celebrations.

title: Rose Orange Pure Zari Kanjivaram Silk Saree
description: Rooted in simplicity, this Rose Orange Pure Zari Kanjivaram Silk Saree is an everyday classic. Zari checks lend quiet texture to the soft, fluid drape, finished with an orange selvedge offering just the right lift. The pallu stays minimal with only fine zari lines that echo the saree’s easy elegance. Paired with a matching checked blouse, this saree is light, breathable, and designed for all-day comfort. A lovely choice for everyday grace or simple gatherings that still call for something special.

title: Ananda Blue Pure Zari Kanjivaram Silk Saree with Magenta
description: Some colour pairings carry an effortless charm. This Ananda Blue and Magenta Kanjivaram Silk Saree is one such classic—where a luminous turquoise body meets the richness of magenta in a striking retta pettu korvai border. Woven with fine vertical oosi lines and adorned with alternating Chakram and Annam motifs in pure zari, the body reflects balance and precision. The border features traditional Kanchipuram elements like Gajayani and Annam, intricately laid out in gold zari. A grand pallu with bold Yaali motifs adds weight to the drape, while a plain magenta blouse brings the look together. A poised choice for weddings, temple functions, or festive evenings—this saree is a graceful blend of vibrant colour and enduring design.

title: Lavender Pure Kanjivaram Silk Saree with Red

title: Powder Blue Pure Zari Kanjivaram Silk Saree
description: Powder Blue Pure Zari Kanjivaram Silk Saree, crafted with oosi stripes and adorned with annam and chakram buttas across the body. The bodi pettu border complements the weave, while a rich pallu completes the composition. Paired with a plain blouse, this monotone drape carries a graceful charm, making it a timeless addition for every occasion.

title: Light Rose Pure Zari Kanjivaram Silk Saree
description: This exquisite rose Pure Zari Kanjivaram Silk Saree stands apart for its unique design language. The body is artfully divided with Oosi checks shimmering on the lower half and refined geometric buttas gracing the upper separated by a band of horizontal stripes with buttas that add definition and charm. Monotone in shade, the rose hue brings a regal yet contemporary feel, complemented by a traditional pallu and a plain blouse. Striking in its simplicity, this saree adapts beautifully to any styling equally graceful with antique gold, diamond, or temple jewellery,making it a versatile drape for weddings, festive occasions, or elegant gatherings.

title: Light Pink Tissue Pure Kanjivaram Silk Saree
description: Some sarees don’t just shine—they illuminate every space they enter. This Light Pink Tissue Pure Kanjivaram Silk Saree is one such drape, woven with precision and imagination in Muhurth’s signature Meenakari tissue craftsmanship. The body gleams in full silver zari, layered with floral vines in gold and contemporary floral motifs brought to life through vibrant Meenakari detailing with each blossom touched with hues of orange, green, rose, and gold that pop beautifully against the soft pink tissue canvas. A traditional Korvai Getti Pettu border lends structure and contrast, seamlessly flowing into a richly detailed pallu adorned with classic Kanchipuram motifs. Paired with a plain blouse in matching tone, this saree is regal and graceful perfect for weddings, receptions, or evening gatherings where every detail is meant to dazzle.

title: Bright Red Pure Kanjivaram Silk Saree
description: This striking borderless bright red Kanjivaram silk saree featuring traditional checks woven across the body. The saree is adorned with alternating gold and silver Persian feather motifs, adding a refined and contemporary touch to its classic design. A deep green selvedge at the bottom lends a subtle highlight to the bold red canvas. The pallu, in the same vibrant red, is intricately woven with traditional detailing that enhances its richness. Paired with a contrasting green checked blouse, this ensemble balances timeless artistry with a bold, modern statement—perfect for festive gatherings and special occasions.

title: Dark Magenta Pure Kanjivaram Silk Saree
description: In the deep glow of burgundy, this Pure Kanjivaram Silk Saree carries the quiet rhythm of veldhari stripes along its body. The Traditional Getti Pettu border is graced with the regal yaali, a motif that stands as a guardian of tradition. Every stripe, every form, is crafted with devoted nuance by skilled artisans. This is a weave that reveals its intricacies the longer you behold it. The rich pallu mirrors its timeless spirit, paired with a plain blouse. This is a drape that lends poise and grace to every traditional gathering.

title: Pink Pure Kanjivaram Silk Saree
description: This pure Kanjivaram silk from Muhurth is woven in a soft, luminous pink, its body adorned with muthu kattam veldhari checks that lend a gentle rhythm to the weave. The drape carries an airy lightness, flowing into a contrast ananda blue pallu that mirrors its delicate charm. A richly woven brocade blouse in the same contrast shade completes the look. Effortless to wear and graceful in every fold, it is a beautiful choice for temple visits, intimate gatherings, and and occasions that call for unhurried elegance.

title: Peach Linen Style Pure Zari Kanjivaram Silk Saree
description: A refreshing twist on tradition, this exclusive Muhurth creation brings the understated charm of linen into the richness of Kanjivaram silk. Woven in a soothing peach tone, the body carries a subtle glaze that mimics the look of linen—offering a refined, minimal aesthetic while retaining the luxurious drape and feel of pure silk. Though plain at first glance, the saree reveals a quiet sheen that shifts beautifully with movement.Crafted in a borderless style, the silhouette feels featherlight and contemporary, making it perfect for day-long wear. The pallu is kept elegantly simple, curated to match the overall lightness of the weave and allow the texture to shine through. Completing the ensemble is a dual-tone blouse in a warm orange shot rose—a soft yet striking contrast that elevates the peach body with just the right hint of colour.

title: Violet Pure Kanjivaram Silk Saree with Peach
description: A timeless classic in a blue-violet tone, this Kanjivaram silk saree from Muhurth reflects tradition at its most graceful. The body is adorned with elegant vertical stripes, brought to life through the intricate double nada technique, a testament to the weaver’s finesse. Framed by a soft peach-pink Korvai getti pettu border, the saree features beautifully woven floral creepers and geometric patterns that flow with quiet rhythm. A finely crafted temple rek sits between body and border, anchoring the composition with traditional charm. The pallu unfolds in rich detail, echoing the border’s artistry with a grand and luminous finish. Paired with a plain contrast blouse, this drape is an exquisite choice for weddings, festive gatherings.

title: Red Orange Pure Kanjivaram Silk Saree
description: Woven in an elegant orange-red hue, this pure Kanjivaram silk saree from Muhurth features gold-toned Chakram buttas that dot the body in classic rhythm. The contrast Magenta border is edged with an orange selvedge and matching highlight along the beat, while rose-toned temple reks neatly divide the border from the body. Intricately woven Annapakshi motifs bring definition to the Getti Pettu layout, adding a touch of enduring craftsmanship. The pallu, in a rich rose tone that complements the body with subtle contrast, carries both Chakram and Annapakshi motifs in a grand yet balanced arrangement. Paired with a plain blouse in the same rose tone, this saree is ideal for festive occasions, weddings, and moments that call for refined traditional elegance.

title: Rose Red Pure Kanjivaram Silk Saree with Pink
description: A refined statement in rose red, this Kanjivaram silk saree from Muhurth is woven with intricate precision and quiet opulence. The body is adorned with delicate parrots on winding vines crafted using the Jamdani technique and accented with subtle Meenakari hues, creating a brocade that shimmers softly with every fold.The contrast baby pink border unfolds in a layered array: beginning with traditional Kanchipuram design elements, followed by a finely rendered twill weave that lends a soft, tissue-like texture, and culminating in elegant Meenakari floral vines that trail along its edge. he broad structure of the border adds both weight and visual balance to the drape. A grand and richly detailed pallu carries this narrative forward in seamless harmony. Paired with a brocade blouse in complementing tones, this Muhurth exclusive is a celebration of weaving finesse, ideal for those who seek elegance with artistry woven into every inch.

title: Rose Pure Zari Kanjivaram Silk Saree with Golden Mustard
description: In a radiant pairing of rose and golden mustard, this Pure Zari Kanjivaram Silk Saree is woven in the muthu seer ayiram butta style, with pattu checks lending depth to the body. The korvai seer pettu border in retta pettu combines zari and silk in perfect harmony, adorned with finely rendered rudraksh and annam motifs. Green pattu bands trace the beat of the saree, complemented by a matching selvedge that adds a subtle accent. A rich self pallu continues the border’s artistry with meticulous precision. Paired with a plain blouse, this timeless weave is crafted to grace every occasion with poise and splendour.

title: Black Pure Zari Kanjivaram Silk Saree with Green
description: In the timeless Vanasingaram weave, this Pure Zari Kanjivaram in black and green evokes the splendour of nature and the finesse of vintage craftsmanship. The body carries the intricate forest-inspired brocade in silk, framed by a delicate zari line along the green selvedge. A deep green pallu steeped in tradition and a plain blouse complete the look making it a saree that speaks of artistry preserved through generations.

title: Red Pure Kanjivaram Silk Saree with Peach
description: Draped in the brilliance of red and softened by the elegance of peach, this Pure Kanjivaram Silk Saree embodies the essence of ceremonial grandeur. The brocade body carries an intricate floral jaal interlaced with parrots in shimmering zari, a design that balances opulence with grace. The korvai getti-pettu border in soft peach is adorned with floral creepers, mayil kannu, and salangai motifs, lending a refined contrast to the richness of the body. A self pallu continues the intricacy in gentle detail, while the plain blouse leaves room for styling versatility. Crafted with finesse, this saree becomes a mark of auspicious beginnings and enduring celebration.

title: Vijaya Ananda Pure Zari Kanjivaram Silk Saree
description: A vintage revival, woven in tones that echo timeless elegance. This Vijaya Ananda Pure Zari Kanjivaram Silk Saree features the classic Veldhari weave, its body alternating in dual shades of blue with a luminous play of silk. The traditional getti pettu border is intricately detailed with mango, bhavanji, malli moggu, and muthu seer motifs, edged with a magenta selvedge that lends a vibrant accent. The pallu unfolds in grandeur, adorned with motifs of elephant, mango, and lion, woven in true Kanchipuram tradition. Paired with a plain contrast blouse, this saree is a graceful vintage recreation, perfect for every beautiful occasion.

title: Pakku Pure Kanjivaram Silk Saree with Peach
description: Some sarees don’t just speak — they resonate. This Pakku Pure Kanjivaram Silk Saree with a soft Peach contrast is one such radiant composition from our bridal edit. The body gleams with a rich brocade layout, where Salangai motifs in gold zari cascade in rhythmic grace, echoing the sound of sacred celebrations. The Turning Korvai border is a masterstroke of artistry — intricate and thoughtfully arranged, where traditional elements like Vanki, Mayil, Rudraksh and Floral vines are elevated with subtle Meenakari detailing in magenta, green, and gold. Framed in a warm peach tone, the border lends both softness and splendour. The self pallu is luxuriously woven with age-old motifs in a dense, luminous weave, completing the silhouette with regal flair. Paired with a plain blouse, this saree is a signature Muhurth statement — deeply rooted in tradition, unmistakably radiant, and rich in both colour and technique. A timeless choice for the modern bride who honours tradition with discernment.

title: Off-White Pure Kanjivaram Silk Saree with Lavender
description: This off-white Kanjivaram silk saree carries a serene charm, woven with floral buttas in gold zari across the body. Each motif is gently highlighted with Meenakari detailing, adding soft hints of colour and texture that glow in the light. The lavender Korvai border brings a sense of quiet richness, woven with traditional patterns like mayil kannu motifs and finished with a deep lavender selvedge that completes the silhouette with grace. The pallu carries the same intricate detailing, lending continuity and grandeur to the drape. A plain blouse in matching lavender tones completes the look. Ideal for weddings and special gatherings, this saree is a graceful expression of colour, craftsmanship, and composure.

title: Mustard Vaira-Oosi Pure Kanjivaram Silk Saree
description: A saree that gleams with quiet brilliance — this Mustard Pure Kanjivaram Silk Saree is woven in the timeless Vaira Oosi technique, featuring intricate silver zari stripes interspersed with delicate Chakram buttas across the body. The monotone palette is enhanced by a traditional Korvai Getti Pettu border, adorned with floral creeper motifs, and a grand pallu that extends the border's artistry with grace. Blending the heritage weight of Vaira Oosi with the ease of tissue, this saree offers a fluid drape with a bold, luminous finish. Paired with a matching blouse, this is a striking choice for bridal wear and a graceful companion for the many new beginnings that follow.

title: Dark Meenakshi Pure Zari Kanjivaram Silk Saree
description: The Dark Meenakshi Pure Zari Kanjivaram Silk Saree comes alive in a rare shade of deep wine purple, a colour seldom seen in today’s looms. The body is adorned with delicate mango and floral buttas, while the turning border reimagines tradition with intricate paisleys and contemporary floral artistry. Its rich self pallu seamlessly extends the border’s design, making this monotone drape a statement of timeless sophistication. Completed with a plain blouse, soft to the touch and graceful to wear, this saree is a rare find and an exquisite choice for weddings, festive gatherings, and every occasion that calls for beauty with distinction.

title: Off-White Pure Zari Kanjivaram Silk Saree with Violet
description: In an elegant shade of off-white, this Pure Zari Kanjivaram Silk Saree comes alive with Mayil-Chakram butta woven delicately across the body. The korvai border is accentuated with oosi checks, while a striking brown band at the beat and selvedge lends bold definition to the violet contrast. The pallu unfolds in grandeur, adorned with intricately detailed peacocks, a hallmark of regal Kanjivaram artistry. Paired with a plain blouse, the interplay of checks in the border and motifs in the body creates a weave of great character, making this saree a refined choice for those special occasions where elegance meets distinction.

title: Light Kaki Pure Zari Kanjivaram Silk Saree with Red
description: A luminous shade of light kaki, rare to behold and harder still to recreate, gives this Pure Zari Kanjivaram Silk Saree its timeless charm. The body glimmers with dainty floral buttas while the korvaiseer pettuborder in zari and silk, finished with temple rek carries the quiet grandeur of vintage weaves. The pallu, glowing in rose orange and green matching the selvedge accent, extends the grace of the border in seamless harmony. Completed with a plain blouse, this drape stands as a revival of age-old artistry. An heirloom-worthy piece that celebrates tradition in its most elegant form.
